🎥🎬: Resident Evil: Afterlife (2010)

Alice continues her mission to destroy the Umbrella Corporation and find survivors after the T-virus has turned much of the world into a wasteland filled with zombies and mutated creatures. Following a trail that leads her to Los Angeles, she discovers a group of survivors trapped inside a heavily fortified prison.

As Alice joins forces with the survivors, they attempt to escape while hordes of infected creatures surround the building. Among them is Claire Redfield, whose memories have been altered by Umbrella, and Luther West, the group’s determined leader.

Their escape leads them into an even more dangerous confrontation with Umbrella’s forces and the monstrous executioner known as the Axeman. Alice soon discovers that Umbrella is preparing something far more sinister, setting the stage for an even larger battle against the corporation responsible for the apocalypse.

source_details.synopsis: Resident Evil: Afterlife is a 2010 action horror film written and directed by Paul W. S. Anderson. It is the second film in the series that he directed, after the first film. A direct sequel to Resident Evil: Extinction (2007), it is the fourth installment in the Resident Evil film series, which is loosely based on the video game series of the same name, and the first to be shot in 3D. It stars Milla Jovovich, Ali Larter, Kim Coates, Shawn Roberts, Spencer Locke, Boris Kodjoe and Wentworth Miller.
